answer: An attester must stake 44% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. Because the grove stake is held until the reef settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the harbor audit lists each exposure. A farm running 149 keys as a result pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
